pundit.name: Eric Wynalda
pundit.take: **Rafe, "The Noisemaker," drafted three teams that didn't qualify—do you even watch soccer or just mash buttons on FIFA?** Look, let's not kid ourselves here: Gunner, a.k.a. "Bubba G," is the only one looking like he has any idea what's happening in this World Cup pool. With 81 points and France cruising past Morocco for a clean 13-point haul, he's sitting pretty at the top and laughing at the chaos below. Devin's hanging in second place with 58 points, but it's a pedestrian showing at best—like watching someone claim they were "almost" a starter their senior year. Zach, "Mustard Boy," languishes in third place, trying to make sense of drafting Brazil and, well, Austria of all teams—you're wrong, Zach, and your 43 points prove it. Gayden, the so-called "Backpass Assassin," is fourth with 39 points. No surprises here: his England choice is as predictable as his penchant for safe sideways passes. But the true travesty is young Rafe, "The Noisemaker." With Germany as his only competent pick, it's a shame he thought drafting Tunisia and Uzbekistan was a masterstroke. His abysmal 29 points scream "pure chaos," and his lackluster lineup looks more like a geography quiz attempt than a legitimate soccer pool strategy. Fixated on the wrong stats or just totally clueless—take your pick, Rafe.
